name: GStandaardBijzonderKenmerk
title: G-Standaard bijzondere kenmerken (Opiumwet subset)
description: The Opiumwet-related subset of the G-Standaard bijzondere kenmerken (bestand BST401T, thesaurus BST922T). No OID is registered for this table in the HL7 NL or Nictiz registers, so a Digitalis URI is used. Content is 'fragment': only the codes this interface emits are enumerated, not the full table.
